one_liner: Mid-to-senior federal buyer for ICE: plan, solicit, negotiate, award and manage complex supply and service contracts under federal acquisition rules.
fit_summary: This GS-12 role requires FAC-C (Professional) or an equivalent contracting certification at the time of application, plus a year of GS-11-level contracting such as cost and price analysis. Daniel has no contracting certification, and his proposal and purchasing work is contractor-side, so the certification requirement screens him out.
eligibility: Open to the public and to federal career-transition (ICTAP/CTAP) applicants under Direct Hire Authority, so no federal status is needed.
Selective placement factor: you must hold a FAC-C (Levels I-III or Professional), DAWIA Contracting, or DoD Contracting Professional certification and submit a copy with the application.
Basic requirement: a bachelor's degree in any field, or 24 semester hours in business-related fields, verified by transcripts you must upload.
Specialized experience: one year at the GS-11 equivalent doing cost/price analysis, determining contract type, preparing solicitations and evaluation criteria, and developing negotiation strategies.
You must pass the USA Hire online assessment cut score and a pre-employment drug test.
strategy: Skip this one: the certification requirement is a hard screen-out.
Put the effort into entry-level GS-1102 contract specialist postings at GS-7 or GS-9 that are open to the public and don't require certification, which are the realistic entry point.
interview_questions: Walk us through how you would perform a price analysis for a services requirement when there is limited competition.
How do you decide the appropriate contract type for a complex requirement?
Describe a negotiation where you had to balance a customer's needs against compliance rules.
Tell us about a time you managed a post-award problem with a contractor's performance.
watch_outs: The contracting certification requirement is a hard screen-out, and his resume lists none.
There is no promotion potential above GS-12, and the duty locations are Irving TX, Orlando FL, or Washington DC, so the DC option is a commute from Manassas.
Consulting experience on the contractor side counts only if it clearly involved acquisition tasks at GS-11 complexity.
